plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for F5 load balancer. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, sessions/connections, interface traffic, failover role, and configuration sync status, for BIG-IP (enterprise PEN 3375).
name: Loadbalance

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the host CPU utilization of the F5 BIG-IP load balancer (F5-BIGIP-SYSTEM-MIB sysGlobalHostCpuUsageRatio5s, 5-second ratio). Sustained high CPU usage may indicate heavy traffic-processing load.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total host memory of the F5 BIG-IP load balancer (F5-BIGIP-SYSTEM-MIB sysStatMemoryTotal, in bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the used host memory of the F5 BIG-IP load balancer (F5-BIGIP-SYSTEM-MIB sysStatMemoryUsed, in bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the host memory utilization of the F5 BIG-IP load balancer, derived as used / total * 100. High memory pressure can degrade connection-handling performance.

metrics.name: lb_current_connections
metrics.description: This metric reports the number of current client-side connections on the F5 BIG-IP load balancer (F5-BIGIP-SYSTEM-MIB sysStatClientCurConns). A rapid rise can indicate a connection surge or capacity pressure.

metrics.name: failover_ok
metrics.description: Whether this BIG-IP is in a normal failover role. 1 means active or standby. 2 means offline, forced offline, or the role is unknown, so high availability may already be lost.

metrics.name: failover_status
metrics.unit: [{"name":"未知","id":0,"color":"#8c8c8c"},{"name":"离线","id":1,"color":"#ff4d4f"},{"name":"强制离线","id":2,"color":"#ff4d4f"},{"name":"备用","id":3,"color":"#1ac44a"},{"name":"主用","id":4,"color":"#1ac44a"}]
metrics.description: Current failover role of this BIG-IP: active, standby, offline, forced offline, or unknown. Active and standby are expected. Offline, forced offline, or unknown means the device is not in a normal high-availability role.

metrics.name: sync_ok
metrics.description: Whether device-group configuration sync looks healthy. 1 means in sync, currently syncing, or running standalone with no device group. 2 means a manual sync is needed, sync failed, peers are disconnected, versions do not match, only some peers received the last sync, the first sync has not finished, or the status is unknown. Standalone is not a failure.

metrics.name: sync_status
metrics.unit: [{"name":"未知","id":0,"color":"#8c8c8c"},{"name":"同步中","id":1,"color":"#1677ff"},{"name":"需手工同步","id":2,"color":"#faad14"},{"name":"已同步","id":3,"color":"#1ac44a"},{"name":"同步失败","id":4,"color":"#ff4d4f"},{"name":"对端失联","id":5,"color":"#ff4d4f"},{"name":"单机","id":6,"color":"#1ac44a"},{"name":"等待首次同步","id":7,"color":"#faad14"},{"name":"版本不兼容","id":8,"color":"#ff4d4f"},{"name":"部分同步","id":9,"color":"#faad14"}]
metrics.description: How this BIG-IP stands with its device-group configuration: in sync, syncing, standalone, waiting for a manual or first sync, partially synced, failed, disconnected from peers, on an incompatible version, or unknown. Standalone is a normal single-device setup, not a fault.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports chassis temperature in degrees Celsius (sysChassisTempTemperature), aggregated as the maximum across sensors. High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction and risk thermal shutdown.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports chassis fan status (sysChassisFanStatus: good(1)/bad(0)/notpresent(2)), normalized so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault. Aggregated as the maximum across fans so any non-good fan surfaces.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports chassis power-supply status (sysChassisPowerSupplyStatus: good(1)/bad(0)/notpresent(2)), normalized so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault. Aggregated as the maximum across supplies so any non-good PSU surfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifAdminStatus
metrics.description: This metric indicates the administrative status of the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifOperStatus
metrics.description: This metric reflects the actual operational status of the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifSpeed
metrics.description: This metric indicates the maximum data transmission speed supported by the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifInErrors
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of incoming error packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutErrors
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing error packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInDiscards
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of incoming discarded packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutDiscards
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing discarded packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInUcastPkts
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of incoming unicast packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutUcastPkts
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing unicast packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: loadbalance_current_connections
metrics.description: This metric reports the current number of active connections through the load balancer.
